name: std::tuple_element<std::pair>

declarations.code:
template <std::size_t I, class T1, class T2>

struct tuple_element<I, std::pair<T1, T2>>;

intro: The partial specializations of std::tuple_element for pairs provide compile-time access to the types of the pair's elements, using tuple-like syntax. The program is ill-formed if I >= 2.
